snippet.title: The Great Coffee Caper | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
The Great Coffee Caper is a cute and cozy RPG where it's up to Detective Hootsworth to figure out who stole the town's coffee beans! Uncover clues in fast-paced clue battles, question the charming townsfolk, and figure out hoooo dunnit!

DEMO COMING SOON!
Featured in @ClemmyGames Best Indie Games Summer Showcase 2025!

Thanks to  @JustZectro  for the music!
Thanks to Jacob for the art! https://jacobscomicz.carrd.co/
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
